description:
Arrange the three product images on Slide 2 of the presentation 'product_showcase.odp'. You must:
1. Select all three images (Watch, Camera, Headphones).
2. Align them to their vertical centers (Format > Align > Center Vertically).
3. Distribute them evenly horizontally (Format > Distribute > Horizontally).

Do not move the images to a different slide or delete them. Save the presentation when finished.
